vibe_rationale: Deep log and longboard community at its core over 35 years, but contest-led and a single scene, so a step below SURPLUS on multi-format curation.
fit_notes: Adult-heavy longboard community in a wellness-minded holiday town, and AG1, a health and nutrition brand, is already a major partner, so health brands have precedent here. Ten days leave room for a recovery or wellness space beside the contest, and the 39,000 figure is organiser-reported.
